premium_index_1h.semantics: Official dampened EMA rate series used for funding rate calculation
premium_index_1h.formula: clamp(EMA(Impact Margin Basis), -0.05%, +0.05%) + interest rate dampener
premium_index_1h.prohibited_usage: Strictly prohibited to use as direct basis (perp - index)/index

book_depth_semantics.operational_boundary: Static visible depth ladder proxy only; strictly prohibited to claim microsecond L2 orderbook reconstruction or true execution slippage backtesting.
book_depth_semantics.authority_limitation_note: BookDepth cumulative depth/notional at +-1% to +-5% is an observed structural schema from S3 sample data, not an officially published Binance mathematical formula. Strictly treated as a low-frequency discrete visible depth proxy, prohibited from claiming official matching slippage semantics.

funding_rate_semantics.billing_frequency: Per-symbol specific interval (e.g. 4 hours for REEF during extreme event, standard 8 hours)
funding_rate_semantics.operational_boundary: Only demonstrates historical discrete settlement rates; strictly prohibited to claim simulated net portfolio carry PnL without accounting for borrow cost, slippage, and basis loss.
